figurative_meaning_en: Deity in the form of the common people
similar_in_english: Vox populi, vox Dei (The voice of the people is the voice of God)
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমাদের সংস্কৃতিতে গণদেবতার ধারণা গভীরভাবে প্রোথিত।
example_sentences_in_english: He holds the common people in the highest regard as deities.
The concept of the masses as deities is deeply embedded in our culture.
note: Refers to elevating the public to a divine status in socio-cultural contexts
